name: gh-flow-skills
description: One-shot issue-to-PR composition skills — chain the atomic GitHub skills into a single run

plugins.name: gh-flow
plugins.description: Carry a GitHub issue all the way to a reviewed PR in one run. Four skills: the ordinary path from an issue number; autopilot, from an approved spec; a backlog drain that finishes only when every deferred item has become an issue of its own; and dependency waves that run a set of issues in parallel worktrees with a live-verify barrier between waves.
